# AgentX documentation

## Introduction

AgentX is a terminal based AI agent for building and modifying real software projects. It is designed around an inspectable loop: understand the request, read the repository, plan the implementation, execute changes with real tools, and verify the result.

## Installation

Install with npm, Homebrew, or JSR:

```bash
npm install -g @agent-qofeno/agentx-cli
brew tap SohailKhan0525/agentx && brew install agentx
npx jsr add @agent-qofeno/agentx-cli
```

## Guides

- Providers: cloud and local model configuration.
- Local models: Ollama and LM Studio workflows.
- Architecture: plan, read, execute, verify.
- Commands: slash commands and keyboard shortcuts.
- Stacks: framework and styling guidance.
- Services: common integrations.
- Security: credential and workspace practices.
- FAQ: common questions.

The canonical, expanded content lives at https://agentx.js.org/docs/.
